race.comment: DRAGON LINK (1) is the one to beat after resuming with a dominant pillar-to-post Mdn win at Eagle Farm to justify favouritism. Expecting him to go on with it. LIFE AFTER LOVE (3) looms as the immediate threat after running third in a BM65 at Doomben, only beaten 1.1L. Her 1100m record reads well enough to keep her firmly in the contest. BODMIN MOOR (7) knuckled down strongly to get the verdict at the Gold Coast last time. Draws well, gets in light and has plenty of scope for improvement. Deserves respect. QUANTUM OVERDRIVE (17) returned with a bang at Kilcoy and now gets a key switch in Maloney. Not dismissing.
